nodes.label: Actually Credible Source
nodes.description: The testimony or evidence comes from a historically verified, not-chronically-wrong source. Track record matters.

nodes.label: Brain Glitch (Bias)
nodes.description: The agent has a relevant cognitive bias — confirmation bias, anchoring, the works. Brain running legacy code.

nodes.label: Hard Receipts
nodes.description: The available evidence is strong, well-corroborated, and survives scrutiny. Not just vibes — actual tea.

nodes.label: Backed-Up Take
nodes.description: The agent holds a belief that is epistemically justified — they have the receipts and they're real.

nodes.label: Actually Real Facts
nodes.description: The believed proposition actually corresponds to how things are. No cap, no fiction — maps to territory.

nodes.label: Full Send (Locked In)
nodes.description: The agent has certified knowledge — backed-up take that's also true. Assuming no Gettier demons showed up.

nodes.label: Spreading The Lore
nodes.description: The agent shares their knowledge via testimony. The lore propagates. Group chat gets the download.

nodes.label: The Group Chat Knows
nodes.description: The knowledge has propagated into the collective epistemic sphere. It's in the air now. Shared lore achieved.
